author: Wei Ling
review: Best chicken rice in the east, hands down. The chilli is fragrant and the queue moves fast. Auntie even remembered my order.

author: Marcus T.
review: Waited 35 minutes and the rice was cold by the time I got it. Staff seemed overwhelmed at lunch. Taste was fine but not worth that wait.

author: Priya
review: Found a long hair in my laksa and when I pointed it out they just shrugged. Absolutely not coming back.

author: Daniel L.
review: Solid char kway teow, good wok hei. A bit oily for my taste but that is kind of the point. Cash only, bring small notes.

author: Hafiz
review: It is okay lah. Nothing special, nothing bad. Prices have crept up though — used to be cheaper last year.

author: Jocelyn
review: Came for the kaya toast and stayed for the kopi. Cosy corner stall, friendly uncle, very nostalgic vibes.

author: Ahmad R.
review: Overpriced and bland. Seven dollars for a tiny portion of prata that was soggy in the middle. Disappointed.

author: Chloe
review: Lovely chendol, not too sweet, generous on the gula melaka. Seating is cramped but the dessert makes up for it.

author: Ben
review: Tables were dirty and nobody cleared them for ages. Food was average. Hygiene really let it down for me.

author: Siti
review: My go-to teh tarik every morning. Consistent, hot, and the uncle pulls it properly. Cannot complain at all.
